text:
hida: I'm opening a tiny PR to refresh the Hello Petal quickstart. Targets: shorten auth examples, add a one-line first-deploy (docker run), fix two stale links, and add a one-line expected output. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024
ravi: love it. can we make the curl auth example copy-paste friendly (one line) and prefer `export REDWOOD_API_KEY` in examples? also add a short migration note if older guides use REDWOOD_TOKEN.
noor: also include a minimal JS async snippet (6 lines or less) and a 1-line Python example. New users search for async/await first.
hida: plan: curl -> JS async -> Python minimal -> docker run pinned tag -> Troubleshooting 3 bullets. I'll replace /getting-started/local -> /deploy/local-run.
docs-bot: preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/1024 (ETA ~2m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ravi: for docker run, pin the tag e.g. `redwood/hello-petal:0.6.0` and include a tiny health check `curl http://localhost:8080/health` with expected JSON so learners know it's working.
noor: small UX nit: prefer fenced code blocks with ```bash for shell and ```js for JS. Also call out CLI login briefly as an option.
hida: added CLI login callout, pinned docker image to 0.6.0, and used fenced blocks. curl auth example now one-liner: ```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx && curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/hello
# expected: {"message":"hello petal"}
```
ravi: add a tiny Migration note: "Some older content used REDWOOD_TOKEN; prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY. Both accepted during migration." Keep it short.
noor: Troubleshooting bullets please: 1) 401 -> check REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) 502 -> model mismatch or incompatible quantization 3) port conflicts -> ensure 8080 free. Include `docker logs` snippet for debugging.
hida: added Troubleshooting, small `docker logs` example, and a 6-line JS async snippet plus a 1-line Python example. Squashed WIP commits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 - requesting review from @ravi @noor
preview-bot: preview deployment started for commit sha: c3f7a9 (status: building) :building_construction:
noor: link-check flagged one redirect which I fixed in commit c3f7a9, preview updated. small editorial: prefer the word "pin" vs "freeze" when talking about tags.
ravi: LGTM. please squash and add a concise PR description listing changes (auth, curl, JS/Python snippets, pinned image, link fix, troubleshooting).
hida: squashed and updated PR description. Merging when CI green. thanks everyone :tada:
docs-bot: merged to main at 3920123686
